text: Olga's birthday is 14 May. She's really into pottery at the moment, mentioned wanting a proper set of clay tools.
Remind me to ask Santiago how dinner with his in-laws went on Saturday
chiara vegan now (since jan) and off gluten too. no oat milk, she hates it

Call with Teresa — she's coming down on the 3rd of June, arriving about 4pm. Need to book a table somewhere with decent veggie options because her husband Arturo is coeliac and she doesn't eat red meat. She also said Arturo's been a bit low since he retired in the summer, so it'd be nice to make a fuss of him, maybe that tapas place he liked last time.
Alejandro (Ale) turns 40 on 22/11. his wife's planning a surprise thing at the Crown, Sat 23rd at 8. dont say anything
Need to post Afua's parcel before the last collection Friday 3pm
Michael said his dad's in hospital again, op is tomorrow morning. He sounded wrecked. Text him tomorrow evening to see how it went.
Jun doesnt drink, just sparkling water or ginger beer. good to know for future
Isaac's dog Biscuit had three teeth out yesterday, still very groggy apparently
Agnieszka (Aga) loves dark chocolate, the 85% stuff, and anything with cherries. Her name day is 16 December, which is a bigger deal than her birthday in her family.

So I bumped into Seo-yeon at the station and she was saying her sister is getting married in Seoul on the 9th of October next year, and she's flying out on the 2nd, um, and she's quite stressed about the speech because she's maid of honour. Remind me to message her nearer the time to see how the speech is going.

Antoine and Manon are having people round for Manon's 30th, Sat 8 March from 7ish. Should bring wine - they both drink red, Manon won't touch rosé. Antoine said she's been dropping hints about a cookery course, so that could be a joint present from a few of us. Ask Sam and Olga if they want to chip in.
Milan's birthday drinks this Friday are off, he's got covid. Rearranging for sometime after the 20th
pick up dry cleaning tmrw before 10
Anika really nervous about her driving test on Thursday 14/03 at 11:20. Text her good luck that morning!!
jack hates coriander. like actively. also allergic to shellfish (prawns at least)
Chantal mentioned her mum turns 70 on the 1st of August, they're doing a family lunch somewhere in Kent
Ann + Juan anniversary 12 Sept - 25 yrs!! kids organising a do. I should get them a card at least

Pooja's back from Kerala, said the food was unreal. She's bringing me some of her aunt's lime pickle when we meet next Tuesday lunchtime. Her cousin Jun is getting married out there in January, a three day thing, and she's already stressing about what to wear.
Karim's fasting for Ramadan so no lunches for a bit. He suggested iftar at his on the 18th instead, around quarter past 7.
Alice is doing Dry January again. Also teaching herself to bake sourdough, keeps sending me pics of her loaves

Long catch-up with Caroline on the phone. Her son Liam got into Leeds for medicine and starts in September, she's thrilled but obviously emotional about him leaving home. She's also been struggling with her back, physio twice a week now, and she's trying gluten free to see if it helps with the bloating. Her birthday is the 27th of April, she said a nice candle or some bath stuff, nothing big. Must ring her the week he moves out.
joanna's wedding was saturday. need to ask how the honeymoon in crete went once they're back on the 30th
Arturo collects vinyl, mostly 70s salsa and boogaloo. Could be a good bday present idea, his is 5 Feb

Yusuf coming to stay 2nd-5th Nov. Halal only, and he doesn't eat lamb funnily enough. Pick him up from Euston Friday at 6. He wants to see the Hockney exhibition Saturday morning and he's mad about Turkish breakfasts, so maybe that place on Green Lanes after. Also his birthday is the 4th so get a cake for Sunday night
Mia's little one Anya starts nursery on Monday. Mia is way more nervous about it than Anya is lol
Note to self: book dentist for after the 15th, mornings only
Sam's off booze while he trains for the marathon, race is 13 April. Loves those salted caramel protein bars though
Olga and her husband Sam have a new puppy!! A sausage dog called Pickle. Pop round with a chew toy sometime next week
Santiago Reyes from climbing - lactose intolerant, big on mezcal, birthday 3rd July

Spoke to Chiara this morning, her grandad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is Thursday the 12th at half 9 in Bergamo and she flies out Tuesday night. Send flowers to her flat before she goes. She said her mum isn't coping well at all, and Chiara's the one sorting most of the arrangements. Message her over the weekend to see how she's holding up.
afua's bday TOMORROW. she mentioned wanting the new Sally Rooney, grab it tonight
Michael and his partner are expecting! Due early March. They haven't told his parents yet so keep it quiet
Jun's leaving drinks next Thursday at 5:30, Bar Kroketa. He's moving to the Manchester office in the new year.
Isaac is really into fermenting things, kombucha, kimchi, the lot. Not a fan of anything too sweet.
Remember to ask Agnieszka what her daughter wants for her 8th, it's 21/06 and she said something about Lego Friends
Teresa can't do Sunday lunch anymore, her knee's playing up again. Said we'd try the weekend after.
Dinner at Antoine's on the 19th at 8. He's cooking, I'm doing dessert. Manon's off dairy so sorbet not tiramisu
Milan had his interview at the bank yesterday afternoon, should hear by Friday. Ask him Friday evening if he's heard anything
Anika's partner Jack runs a little coffee stall at the market on Saturdays, oat flat whites are his thing. She's a tea person, Earl Grey, no milk.
chantal + her kids off to Martinique for xmas, leaving 20 dec, back 4 jan
Ann's grandson is being christened on 6 April, 11am at St Mary's. She's asked me to do a reading.
Manon Barros - Mani to everyone - is mad about her allotment. Been eyeing up a fancy pair of Japanese secateurs, could go in with Antoine on those for her 30th.

Voice note. Pooja's dad has his knee replacement on the 2nd of December, early, like a 7am check in. She's taking the week off to look after him and she sounded pretty tired already. I should drop some food round that weekend, she's vegetarian and doesn't eat egg either.
Karim's cat Simba went missing on Tues, turned up this morning thank god
ALICE AND YUSUF ARE ENGAGED. he proposed in Lisbon last weekend. send them a card
Caroline's daughter turns 18 next month, she's thinking a meal out rather than a party
Joanna Walsh, new on the team. Pescatarian, big into cryptic crosswords and true crime podcasts.
Juan said he'll FaceTime Sunday at 10am his time, so 3pm here. Don't forget
oat milk, limes, the good coffee, bin bags
Mia's dad's 60th is on the 30th and she's doing the cake, panicking because she's never made a tiered one. Offer to help her Saturday morning?
Liam's A level results come out 14 Aug, he's dreading it. Text him that morning.

Anya Nowak, my old flatmate, is visiting from Kraków the weekend of the 22nd. She's coeliac so I need to check which places near us do proper gluten free. She also loves a negroni, and she's never been to the Barbican so maybe Saturday afternoon there.
Coffee with Santiago. He's struggling a bit since the redundancy, applying for loads but nothing yet. Take him for lunch next week, my treat
Seo-yeon's Korean cooking class Thursday night got called off, rescheduled for 4 Nov at 7pm
Running the 10k Sunday 9am. Gym Tues and Thurs mornings till then.
Olga says the bbq at hers is now Saturday the 26th, midday. I'm doing salads. Her brother Milan is veggie and her mum doesn't eat pork.
Jack's mum has a scan Wednesday afternoon. He's playing it down but he's obviously worried. Check in with him Weds night
ugh forgot Alejandro's birthday yesterday. send him something today, he likes craft IPAs, the hazy ones

Lunch with Afua and Karim, long one. Afua's sister is moving to Toronto on 1st March for a new job and Afua is gutted about it. Karim's doing his first half marathon on 16 Feb, still having a pint most nights though. We all want a curry night soon, maybe Friday the 7th at 7:30. Afua can't do anything too spicy since her stomach problems. Remind me to sort the booking by Wednesday.
